Now it doesn't check for the cached route expiration in ipv6's
dst_ops->check()
column2: because it trusts dst_gc that would clean the

column1: cached route up when it's expired.
The problem is in dst_gc
column2: it would clean the cached route only

column1: when it's refcount is 1. If some other module (like xfrm) keeps
holding it and the module only release it when dst_ops->check()
fails.
But without checking for the cached route expiration
may always return true. Meanwhile
route
column2: dst_gc couldn't del it. It will cause this cached route

column1: never to expire.
This patch is to set dst.obsolete with DST_OBSOLETE_KILL in .gc
when it's expired
in .check.
Note that this is even needed when ipv6 dst_gc timer is removed
one day. It would set dst.obsolete in .redirect and .update_pmtu
instead
column2: and check for cached route expiration when getting it
